description: Use this for schools near the new homes for sale in a place: by phase (primary or secondary), Ofsted grade (Outstanding, or good or better), grammar schools and single-sex schools. Each school comes with its Ofsted judgement and date, how many new homes for sale are near it, and its nearest developments; by council groups them for "where are the grammar schools". The schools nearest one home are among the area facts of that home. England only.

grammar.description: Grammar schools only: secondaries that select by ability.

place.description: A town, county or council area.
